tradition.description: The Valentinian Gnostic tradition, systematised by Valentinus of Alexandria (c.100–160 CE) and his followers Ptolemy and Heracleon. The Valentinian Pleroma of 30 Aeons in 15 male-female syzygy pairs represents one of the most philosophically sophisticated Gnostic cosmological systems, synthesising Platonic, Pythagorean, and Christian elements. When active, shows Valentinian Aeon cross-references for corresponding Sethian entities.
